newsitem.title: GERMANY: German IBIS DAX slightly lower in pre-bourse trade.
newsitem.headline: German IBIS DAX slightly lower in pre-bourse trade.

text.p: 0813 GMT - German IBIS DAX index down slightly in pre-bourse electronic trade, having earlier hit a new all-time high at 4,477.80 points. Dealers said that 4,500-point level was attainable over the day, DAX future advanced to within 10 points of 4,500 earlier on. Support comes from strongly higher close on Wall Street overnight, and from stable, if slightly weaker, dollar.
* IBIS DAX index down 5.26 points at 4,453.40 points.
* September DAX future at 4,482.5 points, up 12.
* Focus on financial stocks -- Bayerische Hypo-Bank, Vereinsbank, Allianz lower.
